facts.text: I have a table called sales_transaction_summary.
The sales_transaction_summary table includes columns for region, merchandise week, customer type, department, and sales number.
The customer type values in the sales_transaction_summary table include commercial and consumer.
The data includes regions Victoria East and Victoria West.
The data includes departments Timber, Garden, and Power Tool.
I asked for the total sales number across all regions.
I asked to break down sales by customer type.
I asked to show the SQL query that generates the result.
